notes.title: Antipole DX Demo available for Play NYC
notes.notes:
It's time once again for Play NYC. We've been proud to be a part of Play NYC every year so far. This year's Play NYC event is a different experience - an event everyone can experience from home!

As part of the event, we've released an Antipole DX demo. Download the demo on Steam now -- act quick, as the demo is only available through Sunday, August 16th!

This is also a great time to check out other games developed in the NYC area. Click the link below to check them out.

[url=http://www.play-nyc.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36139971/347ec389982b2cf4a88b583a1e3bdb462a89bdb6.jpg[/img][/url]
